{{Top|leg}}
'''Chompers''' were carnivorous creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lutrillia/Legends|Lutrillia]]. They often preyed upon stalled vehicles in the planet's [[Desert/Legends|deserts]].
